doc: The one route manifest for Network capabilities (owner, 2026-10-20).
The Kernel is the entry point for every client, so this file, not a client
framework, names the executor that serves each capability on each platform:
core          installed DS Core with its Network addon: Core itself, or
the Desktop's Network adapter door into Core;
network_unit  the governed Network WASM unit in the page;
refuse        a typed refusal, with its code and message.
`executors` says where each executor exists. Engineering jobs go to Core
wherever Core is installed. In-page operations enter through the Kernel and
go to the Network unit on every host where that unit is admitted
(DECOUPLING-008); until it is admitted on the Desktop they stay on Core there.
`page_lanes` bounds how many jobs a page runs at once; absent, the page uses
its own worker width. Each platform's adapter executes the route it is given
and never chooses one. ds_command_kernel::network_routes decodes and gates
this file; hosts ask `route` natively or `networkRoute` in WASM.
